Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products/service in the bid which are not obsolete in the market a nd has at least 3 years residual market life i.e. the offered product/ service shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 3. Generic Data Sheet of the products/service offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid docu ments. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the products/service specifications offered. In cas e of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / Documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001:2015, certifica tion. 6. Turnover Bidder Turnover Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder are less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitut ion shall be taken into account for these criteria. 7. 7. Past Project Experience For fulfilling the experience criteria Only same and successful Product order c opy and invoice, crac. c. Any other document in support of order execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc 8. The bidder must have full-fledged office/service centre/Branch office in with-in geographical area of UTT AR PRADESH Copy of electricity bill/GST certificate/ trade license/House& water tax etc. to be uploaded do cument should be maximum 3 months old from date tender floating date. 9. Technical committee constituted for bid evaluation can give relaxation for any document which is sole s ubject to discretion of the committee Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The manufacturer should have an in-house NABL accredited laboratory for electrical test, photometry te st and safety test at the manufacturing plant to test the products and generate test reports. 2. The bidder must submit all the relevant documents like UP PWD CAT AAA documents and certificates CRS, BIS, TDS, LM79, LM80, IP, TTC, Photobiology and NABL in-house lab at their manufacturing plant. 3. The manufacturer should have PCB design (driver) and manufacturing facility in the manufacturing plan t. 4. Luminaries and drivers will be of same make to avoid any mistrust and problem in getting spares after s ales. 5. For the service warranty period of 5 years, a declaration has to be attached OEM Letter head.. 6. The manufacturer should have in-house LED Driver (Electronics) design and manufacturing facility with BIS certification as the driver is the key component of the fitting to maintain the warranty of the product. 7. According to Government of India the product manufacturer should have manufacturing facility which w ill promote "Make in India". Factory License, 8. Bidder or OEM Submit Documents ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 9. All the bidders OR OEM are requested to upload all the certificates like warranty, ESC matrix, toll free n umber, valid date or during the tender period. 10. The manufacturer should have dedicated service centres to provide quick response against warranty i n case of any issue is noticed or raised. 11. The contractors/bidders must be authorized by the OEM to participate in the tender and the certificate must be enclosed with the bidder’s documents. 12. OEM Authorization Certificate in proper format should be required for any query or confirmation of info rmation related to the bidder. 13. Non-blacklisting and non-insolvency affidavit in favour of Executive Officer, Nagar Panchayat Kaiserga nj Bahraich along with stamp paper of Rs.10/- shall be uploaded and original copy of affidavit shall be sub mitted by the bidder/OEM to the office within 05 days from the date of bid opening. 14. Audited turnover report of last three years to be uploaded by OEM OR bidder. 15. OEM Make and Brand Registration Certificate to be uploaded. 16. PAN, GST, work experience, ITR will be uploaded. 17. Bidder can also deposit EMD along with fixed deposit receipt made or pledged in the name of A/c). The bank has to certify that the deposit can be withdrawn only on demand or with the approval of the depositor . Undertaking for release of EMD, FDR will be issued by the buyer in favour of the bidder after the bid cover ing letter is duly signed and stamped on the reverse of the FDR. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/proof of FDR along with bid and ensure delivery of hard copy to buyer within 5 days from bid closing date/bid ope ning date. . 3.
